caption: Hadrian's Villa Canopus, Tivoli
composition: Canopus reflecting pool and semicircular exedra colonnade at Villa Adriana · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From beside the pool the camera looks down the long Canopus reflecting pool, its still water mirroring the sky. The semicircular exedra colonnade with its statues fills the right, ruined columns stand on the left, and olive trees frame the left edge. Hills rise behind under the clear 11:02 midday sun.
